mapper.select: select count(1) from mp_flow_task_task t where t.actuator_id=#{actuatorId}

select t.id as id,t.actuator_id as actuatorId, t.interactive_type as interactiveType, t.node_name as nodeName, t.node_id as nodeId, t.node_ip as nodeIp ,t.success_count as successCount, t.error_count as errorCount, t.success_count+t.error_count as totalCount ,t.task_status as taskStatus, t.msg as msg, t.resource_type as resourceType from mp_flow_task_task t where t.actuator_id=#{params.actuatorId}
limit #{offset}, #{limit}
